what: Repligen makes the equipment and consumables used to purify biological drugs: filtration systems, chromatography resins and single-use components that go inside a biotech manufacturing line.
customers: Pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers, and the contract manufacturers who make drugs for them.
money: instruments that monitor a production run
moat: Components written into a drug's approved manufacturing process: changing a filter supplier can require regulatory refiling, so once specified they are bought for the product's life.
risks: Revenue fell from $802M to $632M when biotech customers worked through pandemic-era inventory
102 times free cash flow and 13.5 times sales, a high price for a recovery
A small net loss, so the valuation rests entirely on what comes next
opportunities: Revenue has recovered to $738M and is $806M over the last twelve months
Analysts see about 19% upside, with 19 covering the stock, and new drug approvals keep adding manufacturing lines
watch: Order growth from biotech customers, which leads revenue by a couple of quarters.
